answer: Require each new agent identity to post a time-locked bond that grows in a spiral with each additional identity linked by behavior or funding source. Random juries re-grade its original work, like a reef where each violet marker is checked by neighbors. Honest agents recover the bond over time; a Sybil attacker must lock fresh capital and produce distinct, jury-passing work for every fake, so scaling fakes costs linearly more money and time than one honest identity earns.
